//: Ceilings for the single-file shells. Raise one IN THE COMMIT that needs the bytes, and say what bought them. Checked by scripts/test-spaces-size.mjs.

spaces.//: 176 KiB. Video and audio blocks raised it from 172 KiB: the shell went 166,482 -> 172,722 B (+6,240 B, +3.7%) for the media block type, its renderer case, the poster/print still, the editor chooser and playback switches, and 26 new strings in eight catalogs. Measured on node 26 locally, both numbers from the same machine and the same zopfli. Zopfli (scripts/postbuild-compress.mjs) had taken it from 173,598 to 166,482 B without dropping a feature, and this is a feature spending that headroom rather than a fifth raise for the same bytes. Headroom above the measured number is also deliberate for a duller reason - the shell is mostly one compressed block and the packer's output differs across node versions (one commit measured 130,095 B on node 26 locally and 131,246 B on CI node 24), so a tight ceiling fails in CI for no reason. CI is the number that counts.
